escalation.level2: Kula gatosaken mood panjenengan saweg mandhap. Panjenengan mboten piyambakan. Cobi berbagi ing forum utawi review rencana keselamatan panjenengan.
escalation.level3: Panjenengan katingal ngalami wekdal ingkang abot sanget. Bantuan profesional cumawis kagem panjenengan 24/7.

privacy.title: Kabijakan Privasi & Pangayoman Data
privacy.subtitle: Komitmen RIMA anggenipun ngreksa data kesehatan mental panjenengan miturut UU No. 27 Taun 2022 (UU PDP).
privacy.offlineFirstDesc: Data pribadi kados ta cathetan mood, jurnal, lan rencana kawilujengan kasimpen kanthi otomatis wonten ing piranti panjenengan piyambak. Boten wonten data jurnal pribadi ingkang dipunkintun dhateng server pihak sanes tanpa pasarujukan panjenengan.
privacy.moodDataDesc: Skor mood (1-5), faktor panyebab, cathetan, kasimpen sacara lokal.
privacy.journalDataDesc: Refleksi pribadi dipunolah 100% lokal ing peramban panjenengan.
privacy.communityDataDesc: Cariyos anonim kanthi sesinglon acak kangge njagi jati dhiri panjenengan.
privacy.userRightsDesc: Miturut UU Pangayoman Data Pribadi (UU No. 27/2022), panjenengan kagungan hak jangkep kangge:
privacy.rightAccessDesc: Ngundhuh sedaya data pribadi panjenengan wonten format JSON utawi CSV.
privacy.rightErasureDesc: Mbusak permanen sedaya data panjenengan saking piranti lan server sacara cepet.
privacy.rightAnonymityDesc: Ngginakaken RIMA tanpa kedah nyukani asma asli utawi nomer telpon pribadi.
privacy.crisisSafetyDesc: Algoritma paningalan tembung krisis lumampah sedaya wonten ing peramban panjenengan (client-side NLP matching). Boten wonten seratan darurat ingkang dipunkintun dhateng server.
privacy.wipeDesc: Panjenengan saged mbusak sedaya riwayat mood, jurnal, pangaturan, lan identitas anonim lumantar kaca Profil kanthi tombol "Busak Sedaya Data Permanen".

consent.title: Komitmen Privasi & Kawilujengan RIMA
consent.welcomeDesc: RIMA dipundamel minangka ruang aman digital kangge nyengkuyung kesehatan mental panjenengan. Privasi lan kawilujengan data dados prioritas utami.
consent.offlineFirstDesc: Cathetan mood lan jurnal kajagi wonten ing memori piranti panjenengan piyambak.
consent.anonymousDesc: Boten mbetahaken asma asli utawi nomer HP kangge ngginakaken platform puniki.
consent.controlDesc: Panjenengan gadhah hak ngundhuh utawi mbusak sedaya data miturut UU PDP.
consent.agreeCheckbox: Kula mangertos prinsip privasi puniki lan sarujuk ngginakaken RIMA.

dataWipe.warningDesc: Tindakan puniki badhe mbusak sedaya cathetan mood, entri jurnal, rencana kawilujengan, lan pangaturan saking piranti lan server. Tindakan puniki BOTEN saged dipunbatalaken.
dataWipe.recommendExport: Dipunanjuraken ngundhuh cadangan data JSON rumiyin menawi kepengin nyimpen cathetan.
dataWipe.success: Sedaya data lokal lan cloud kasil dipunbusak.

grounding.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding
grounding.subtitle: An evidence-based somatic method to calm acute panic, sensory overwhelm, and ground awareness in the present moment.
grounding.step5Prompt: Look around your environment. Acknowledge 5 distinct objects in the space around you.
grounding.step5Example: Example: A wall clock, wood grain on the desk, the curtain texture, a coffee mug, leaf shadows.
grounding.step4Title: 4 Things You Can Feel or Touch
grounding.step4Prompt: Bring awareness into your physical body. Touch 4 distinct textures nearby.
grounding.step4Example: Example: The softness of your shirt fabric, coolness of the desk surface, feet on the floor, a ring on your finger.
grounding.step3Prompt: Close your eyes if comfortable. Listen carefully and name 3 sounds around you.
grounding.step3Example: Example: Distant traffic hum, air conditioner breeze, clock ticking, the sound of your breath.
grounding.step2Prompt: Inhale gently through your nose. Notice 2 scents around you, or recall a favorite calming smell.
grounding.step2Example: Example: Fresh laundry scent, coffee or herbal tea, hand lotion, crisp outdoor air.
grounding.step1Prompt: State one kind truth about yourself, or note a small thing you are genuinely thankful for.
grounding.step1Example: Example: "I am safe in this moment and doing my best", or taste a sip of cold water.
grounding.completedDesc: You have anchored your mind and nervous system back into the present moment. Appreciate yourself for this step 🌱
grounding.stillAnxiousNote: It is completely okay if peace takes time. You can try a slow breathing exercise or review your safety plan.
disclaimer.grounding: The 5-4-3-2-1 grounding technique is a somatic self-help tool for nervous system regulation, not a substitute for professional psychotherapy.
assessment.title: Self-Administered Mental Health Screening
assessment.subtitle: Standardized, evidence-based psychometric questionnaires (PHQ-9 & GAD-7) to track your mood dynamics and anxiety patterns.
assessment.noHistory: No assessments recorded yet. Select PHQ-9 or GAD-7 above to start your self-check.
assessment.timeframePrompt: Over the LAST 2 WEEKS, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
disclaimer.assessment: PHQ-9 and GAD-7 screeners are preliminary self-monitoring tools for personal awareness, NOT a clinical diagnosis or psychiatric evaluation.
assessment.opt2: More than half the days (>7 days)
assessment.phq9.q1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
assessment.phq9.q3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
assessment.phq9.q4: Feeling tired or having little energy
assessment.phq9.q6: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let your family down
assessment.phq9.q7: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching television
assessment.phq9.q8: Moving or speaking slowly, or being so restless that you move around much more than usual
assessment.phq9.q9: Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in any way
assessment.gad7.q1: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
assessment.gad7.q2: Not being able to stop or control worrying
assessment.gad7.q3: Worrying too much about different things
assessment.gad7.q5: Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
assessment.gad7.q7: Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen
assessment.phq9.recMinimal: Your emotional state is relatively balanced. Continue caring for yourself with healthy sleep and activities you enjoy.
assessment.phq9.recMild: Some mild signs of mental fatigue detected. Daily breathing exercises and reflective journaling can be beneficial.
assessment.phq9.recModerate: Noticeable emotional weight detected. Dedicate time for recovery, review your safety plan, and confide in someone you trust.
assessment.phq9.recModeratelySevere: Symptoms may be substantially affecting daily life. Consider consulting a licensed mental health professional.
assessment.phq9.recSevere: Your score reflects severe psychological distress. We strongly encourage immediate consultation with a psychologist or psychiatrist.
assessment.gad7.recMinimal: Your anxiety levels are well within the standard range. Keep up your balanced habits.
assessment.gad7.recMild: Mild tension or worry detected. Schedule intentional pause times and gentle breathing relaxation.
assessment.gad7.recModerate: Anxiety is impacting your sense of calm. Practice the 5-4-3-2-1 grounding technique to soothe your nervous system.
assessment.gad7.recSevere: High anxiety levels detected which may drain daily energy. Consultation with a mental health professional is recommended.

cbt.step1Desc: Fokus ing kasunyatan nyata kaya kamera video, tanpa opini utawa asumsi.
cbt.situationPlaceholder: Tuladha: Aku ngirim pesen menyang atasan/kanca awan mau nanging durung dibales nganti sore...
cbt.finalIntensityLabel: Intensitas emosimu saiki sawise restrukturisasi pikiran:
cbt.step2Title: Pikiran spontan apa sing langsung metu?
cbt.step2Desc: Ukara apa sing liwat ing sirah nalika kedadeyan iku? Apa sing kokomongake marang awakmu dhewe?
cbt.thoughtPlaceholder: Tuladha: Dheweke mesthi gething karo aku, aku mesthi ngrusak hubungan karo wong liya...
cbt.thoughtTip: Pikiran otomatis asring krasa nyata banget lan ngyakinake, sanadyan durung mesthi cocog karo kasunyatan sejatine.
cbt.step3Desc: Pilih jebakan pikiran sing mbokmenawa lagi nyambut gawe ing pikiran otomatis mau. Bisa milih luwih saka siji:

desc.catastrophizing: Mbayangake skenario paling ala kaya-kaya mesthi kedadeyan.
desc.all_or_nothing: Ndeleng kahanan mung minangka sukses sampurna utawa gagal total.
desc.mind_reading: Yakin wong liya mbiji negatif tanpa bukti sing gamblang.
desc.overgeneralization: Nganggep siji prastawa ala minangka pola kagagalan tanpa pungkasan.
desc.emotional_reasoning: Ngrasa kuatir/luput mula ngira kahanane mesthi ala.
desc.should_statements: Neken awak dhewe utawa wong liya nganggo aturan kaku 'kudu/kudune'.
desc.personalization: Nyalahake awake dhewe tumrap kedadeyan ing sanjabane kuwasa pribadi.
desc.mental_filter: Mung fokus ing siji babagan ala lan lali marang kabeh babagan becik.

cbt.step4Desc: Ayo dadi hakim utawa detektif sing adil. Pisahake fakta nyata saka praduga emosional:
cbt.evidenceForHint: Bukti konkrit apa sing mbuktekake pikiran otomatis mau bener?
cbt.evidenceAgainstHint: Bukti apa sing nuduhake kemungkinan liya utawa mbantah pikiran iku?
cbt.evidenceAgainstPlaceholder: Tuladha: Wingi dheweke isih aruh-aruh grapyak; mbokmenawa lagi rapat padhet utawa baterene entek...
cbt.step5Desc: Sawise ndeleng bukti loro-lorone, tulis cara pandang anyar sing luwih adil, realistis, lan welas asih marang awake dhewe:
cbt.balancedPlaceholder: Tuladha: Durung dibales ora ateges dheweke gething marang aku. Mbokmenawa lagi sibuk, lan aku tetep aji tanpa kudu oleh kepastian cepet.
cbt.reliefSuccess: Apik banget! Beban emosimu suda {{points}} poin sawise restrukturisasi pikiran.
cbt.reliefNeutral: Terus gladhi pikiran seimbangmu. Restrukturisasi kognitif minangka kaprigelan sing saya kuwat selaras wektu.

disclaimer.tipp: Protokol DBT TIPP minangka katrampilan toleransi distres kanggo stabilisasi krisis lan dudu gantine perawatan medis.

tipp.title: Protokol TIPP (Distress Tolerance)
tipp.subtitle: Intervensi somatik adhedhasar bukti kanggo ngleremake krisis emosi, panik, lan kategangan dhuwur kanthi cepet.
tipp.sudsImproved: Kategangan mudhun {{points}} poin! Awakmu wiwit santai.
tipp.sudsSame: Tingkat kategangan padha. Ora apa-apa, sampeyan bisa nyoba teknik TIPP liyane.
tipp.sudsWorse: Isih krasa tegang. Aja ragu-ragu golek pambiyantu utawa bukak rencana kaslametan.
tipp.highDistressDesc: Sampeyan ora kudu ngadhepi iki dhewekan. Bantuan profesional lan rencana kaslametan cumawis kanggo sampeyan.
tipp.tempShort: Memicu Mammalian Dive Reflex kanggo ngedhunake detak jantung sajrone 30 detik.
tipp.tempSubtitle: Nempelake kompres adhem utawa banyu es ing rai langsung ngrangsang saraf vagus kanggo ngedhunake detak jantung.
tipp.tempStep1: Siapake mangkok isi banyu adhem (10-15°C), serbet teles adhem, utawa es watu dibuntel andhuk.
tipp.tempStep2: Lungguh jejeg, miringake awak maju, banjur tempelake kompres ing ngisor mripat lan pipi ndhuwur.
tipp.tempStep3: Tahan napas kanthi santai (aja peksan) sajrone etungan 30 detik ing ngisor iki.
tipp.tempScienceDesc: Reseptor adhem ing saraf trigeminus ngirim sinyal menyang saraf vagus ing batang otak, ngedhunake detak jantung kanthi alami.
tipp.exerciseShort: Wetokake energi adrenalin lan kategangan liwat obah fisik 60 detik.
tipp.exerciseSubtitle: Bakar keluwihan hormon stres kanthi obah fisik sing ringkes lan semangat.
tipp.exerciseScienceDesc: Nalika panik, awak dikebaki energi glukosa lan adrenalin. Ngetokake energi iki maringi tandha aman marang utek.
tipp.breathingShort: Alonake ritme napas kanthi ngetokake napas luwih dawa kanggo ngaktifake saraf parasimpatetik.
tipp.breathingSubtitle: Ambegan alon lan jero kanthi wektu ngetokake napas luwih dawa tinimbang narik napas.
tipp.breathingScienceDesc: Nalika sampeyan ngetokake napas alon-alon, diafragma munggah lan maringi pituduh marang saraf vagus kanggo ngalonake detak jantung.
tipp.breatheFullDesc: Kasedhiya teknik Cyclic Sighing kanthi swara mangkok Tibet.
tipp.pmrShort: Kencengake lan uculake 5 kelompok otot awak kanggo ngilangi kategangan fisik.
tipp.pmrSubtitle: Kencengake otot nalika narik napas (5s), banjur uculake kabeh nalika ngetokake napas (10s).
tipp.pmrHandsDesc: Gegem tangan loro kanthi kenceng, kencengake otot lengen.
tipp.pmrShouldersDesc: Angkat pundhak dhuwur nyedhaki kuping, rasakake kategangan ing gulu.
tipp.pmrJawDesc: Gathukake untu kanthi rapet lan kerutake bathuk sarta mripat.
tipp.pmrAbdomenDesc: Kencengake otot weteng lan dhadha kanthi kuat.
tipp.pmrLegsDesc: Tekuk driji sikil mlebu lan kencengake pupu sarta kempol.
